name: The Loud Sword
pitch: Your crits and dodges are counted, not rolled, so you study the opponent, call the blow out loud in front of nine tiers of paying customers, and it lands exactly where you rehearsed it.

new.name: Called Blow
new.effect: Your crit and evade take no draw: chance adds to a count on each hit, and the hit that fills it to 1 crits or is slipped, and the count falls by 1.
new.second_home: any crit or evade build; NPC champions

new.name: Rehearsal
new.effect: Foreseen fights only, a prepared item: you choose where both counts of Called Blow start.
new.second_home: any Called Blow user; sect examiners

new.name: Shown Face
new.effect: +2 per point of presence above 45, up to +60.
new.second_home: any courtier, duellist or sect envoy

new.name: All Eyes
new.effect: Per point of presence above 45: +0.4 crit_chance_pct, +1 crit_damage_pct, +0.5 evade_pct, inside Combat's caps.

new.name: The Answer
new.effect: +0.5 to the crit count for each hit slipped.

new.name: Losing Face

new.second_home: any build reading a talent live

questions: A counted crit can be aimed, so it is worth more than a rolled one at the same rate. Should Called Blow cost something for that, or is the fragility of the script the price?
May a talent be read live in a fight? Losing Face needs one more exception to compile-once.
Should the arena be real, with tickets and a purse?
